{{Top}}
A '''data rod''', also known as a '''memory rod''' or '''datastick''', was a device used for information storage, similar to a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] or [[Data cube/Legends|data cube]]. Data rods were often found in [[Library/Legends|libraries]] and could be inserted into [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]].<ref name="EN">{{JournalCite|8|The Gree Enclave}}</ref> 

A collection of datasticks were used in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and were held in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]]. In the aftermath of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] was looking through a series of these devices when [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] [[Skirmish in the Jedi Temple|attacked]] him. Throwing one of the spheres to the ground, the resulting explosion allowed him to distract the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].<ref name="CN">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>
